source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of probability in inheritance, block for block; the book's problems are self-checks with answers (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Genes aik nasl se doosri nasl mein ittefaqan (randomly) jate hain. Is liye naye allele milapon ka hisaab riyazi ehtimal (mathematical probability) se lagaya jata hai. Probability ka matlab hai ke koi khaas nateeja kitni baar aata hai.

Aik ya do genes (jaise RrYy × RrYy) ki probability Punnett square se nikal sakti hai. Lekin bohat se genes (jaise AaBbCcDdEe × AaBbCcDdEe) ke liye Punnett square bohat bara aur mushkil ho jata hai, is liye probability ke qaide (rules) istemal hote hain.
Probability = kisi waqiye (event) ke hone ki tadaad ÷ kul mumkina nataij (total possible outcomes).
Misaal: agar 7,324 matar ke beejon mein 1,850 jhurridar hon to probability 1,850 ÷ 7,324 = 0.253 hai, yaani taqreeban har 4 beejon mein se 1.

blocks.title: Performing and Recoding (kar ke dekhein)
blocks.text: Dice 100 baar phenkein aur probability ke qaide se andaza lagayein ke kitni baar chhakka (six) aayega. Har phenk par chhakke ki probability 1/6 hai, pichhle nataij chahe kuch bhi hon. To 100 baar mein taqreeban 100 × 1/6, yaani lag bhag 17 chhakke aane chahiyen. Apni ginti likh kar is andaze se milayein.

Product rule kehta hai ke do ya zyada azad (independent) waqiyat ke aik saath hone ki probability un ki alag alag probabilities ko zarb (multiply) kar ke milti hai. Misaal: aik dice par chhakka aane ki probability 1/6 hai; do dice par dono chhakke aane ki probability (1/6) × (1/6) = 1/36 hai.
Product rule se fertilization ke nataij ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Misaal 1 (Aa × Aa)
blocks.problem: Aa × Aa se aa bachche ki probability kya hai?
steps: Har walid 1/2 probability se a wala gamete deta hai.
blocks.answer: Is liye aa bachche ki probability = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4.

blocks.title: Misaal 2 (RrYy × RrYy)
blocks.problem: RrYy × RrYy se gol peele bachche ki probability kya hai?
steps: Gol beej ki probability 3/4 aur peele beej ki probability 3/4 hai (har jora akela 3:1 deta hai).
blocks.answer: Is liye gol peele bachche ki probability = (3/4) × (3/4) = 9/16.

blocks.text: Yeh qaida un waqiyat par lagta hai jo mutually exclusive hon, yaani aik waqt mein sirf aik ho sakta hai. Kisi aik ke hone ki probability un ki alag alag probabilities ko jama (add) kar ke milti hai. Misaal: chhe rukh wale dice par 1 aane ki probability 1/6 aur 6 aane ki 1/6 hai; to 1 ya 6 aane ki probability (1/6) + (1/6) = 1/3 hai.

blocks.title: Misaal
blocks.problem: Aa × Aa cross mein dominant phenotype (AA ya Aa) teen tareeqon se ban sakta hai:
steps: Male se A + female se A (AA)
Male se A + female se a (Aa)
Male se a + female se A (Aa)
blocks.answer: Is liye dominant phenotype ki kul probability = (1/4) + (1/4) + (1/4) = 3/4.

blocks.text: Analyzing, Interpreting and Communication (masail hal karein)
Neeche ke genetic masail khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Phenylketonuria aur albinism do recessive bimariyan hain jo azad ho kar (independently) aage jati hain. Maa aur baap dono, dono khasiyaton ke liye heterozygous hain. Bachche mein (a) phenylketonuria, (b) albinism, (c) dono hone ki probability kya hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Pp × Pp se pp ki probability 1/4. (b) Aa × Aa se aa ki probability 1/4. (c) Dono aik saath: product rule se (1/4) × (1/4) = 1/16.

blocks.prompt: Aik gene ke do alleles hain: dominant C aur recessive c. CC × Cc cross ke bachchon mein homozygous dominant, homozygous recessive aur heterozygous ka hissa (proportion) kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: CC walid sirf C deta hai; Cc walid C ya c barabar deta hai. Is liye 1/2 CC (homozygous dominant), 1/2 Cc (heterozygous) aur 0 cc (homozygous recessive).

blocks.prompt: TtYy matar ka paudha self-pollinate hota hai aur aik beej ittefaqan chuna jata hai. (a) Is beej se lamba (tall) aur hare beej wala paudha banne ki probability kya hai? (b) Agar paudha lamba aur peele beej wala nikle to us ke TTYY hone ki probability kya hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Lamba 3/4 × hara 1/4 = 3/16. (b) Lambe paudon mein TT 3 mein se 1 (TT, Tt, tT), aur peele beej walon mein YY 3 mein se 1; is liye (1/3) × (1/3) = 1/9.

items: Probability = event ke hone ki tadaad ÷ kul mumkina nataij.
Product rule: azad waqiyat aik saath, probabilities zarb karein (Aa × Aa se aa = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4).
Sum rule: mutually exclusive waqiyat mein se koi aik, probabilities jama karein (Aa × Aa se dominant = 3/4).
